large_case_control: At n=64/k=2 with 63 copies of the chosen BDC base and one independent member, exact decoded amplification is 3.05810546875x, passing <=8x. Thus member count alone is not a sufficient negative discriminator.
causal_threshold: Under unchanged 8192-byte member and no shared 48-byte substring, nonbase membership >=8 suffices to exceed the <=8x frozen selected decode limit even with zero metadata (2*8192 + 8*6641 > 8*8192); this is sufficient not necessary, since source-equivalent cases can fail already with 6 nonbase members.
negative_not_overreach: Do not generalize the previous 54/54 independently unrelated repeated-group rejection to every 64+ file or every xattr-bearing filesystem. Key discriminator is actual base+all-program raw decoded context and count of nonbase edit programs.
strongest_simple_control: Canonical r24 logical content dedup exists, but previous 48/54 optimistic projected density wins must not be advertised as shipping product results. Preserve six losing cases.
